title: Declaration of NAV on a quarter ending day, which is a holiday.

## CIRCULAR 

#### REF: IRDAI/F&I/INV/CIR/248/1 2/2022 

### 26" December, 2022 

#### Sub: Declaration of NAV on a quarter ending day, which is a holiday. 

quarter, even non-business day with the NAV as per the financials of ULIP Funds on that day. | to IRDAI Investment Regulations, 2016 and by virtue under Regulation Investment Regulations, 2016, it is clarified that Life Insurers can declare NAV on last day of each Attention is drawn to Para 2 and 3 of Schedule of the power conferred 17 of IRDAI if it is a non-business day, to sync the published NAV of a quarter end 

(Ammu Venkata Ramana)
